messages:
nora_sre: Postmortem follow-up: capturing concrete remediation steps for GPU capacity & autoscale. Short owners + timelines here so INF board matches.

ashley_platform: I'll own the scheduler experiments (staggered warmup + adjusted scaleDown). Will run quick AB on staging today.

devon_scheduler: I'll file the quota request for eu-west dedicated pool. Proposal: +6 GPUs staggered (+3 now, +3 in 2 weeks). Draft by Thu.

maria_capacity: I'll run headroom sims that include the 03:00 UTC batch spikes and share CSV. Expect results by Wed morning.

ben_oncall: Adding emergency manual scale runbook and a Slack shortcut to trigger warmup. ETA: tomorrow.

infra-bot: Created INF-4705: "Scheduler AB + warmup job" (owner: ashley_platform) | due 2024-07-11

nora_sre: Agreed owners/dates: scheduler AB @ashley_platform due 2024-07-11, quota PR @devon_scheduler due 2024-07-13, headroom sims @maria_capacity due 2024-07-10, ops runbook @ben_oncall due 2024-07-09.

ashley_platform: Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> full over 24-48h. Health gates: 99th latency + errors within 5% of baseline. Config snippet I'm testing:
```
autoscaler:
  targetUtilization: 0.72
  preWarmGPUs: 1
  scaleDownDelaySeconds: 75
```

devon_scheduler: PR link when ready will include cost delta and rollback plan; tagging finance in the PR.

maria_capacity: Early sim: batch spikes cause tail usage needing +3 GPUs; with pre-warm 1 GPU we can avoid most tail pressure. Uploading report: https://internal/reports/headroom-224678.csv

ben_oncall: Runbook snippet added to ops-playbooks. Manual emergency command + checklist included. Also scheduled a monthly headroom report job.

nora_sre: Two follow-ups: (1) propose shifting batch window if sims show big improvement, (2) ensure quota PR includes alert thresholds so we auto-notify before headroom hits.

ashley_platform: I'll add batch deprioritization rule to the scheduler ticket.

devon_scheduler: Will add alert rules post-merge.

maria_capacity: If shifting batch to 05:00 UTC reduces tail by >25% I'll recommend schedule change.

infra-bot: Created INF-4706: "Quota PR review" (owner: devon_scheduler) | due 2024-07-13

nora_sre: Great. Keep links and canary logs in this thread. We'll re-check in 6 days. Thanks all.
